mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: An upward crossing of the unemployment rate above 6.5% triggers a loss of investor confidence, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in triggered instances are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the unemployment rate does not cross the 6.5% threshold.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decrease in the federal funds rate and increase in GDP demand (GDPC1) signal accommodative monetary policy, amplifying equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction does not correlate with positive returns (IC < 0.03 over 20 days) or the proxies move in the opposite expected directions.

mechanism_narrative: Rising industrial production (INDPRO) coupled with stable inflation (CPIAUCSL) indicates a late-cycle expansion, prompting market optimism and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO rising and CPIAUCSL stable for 3 months
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion regimes, 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite the signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in housing-related demand (HOUST) reflects robust economic activity, driving equity valuations higher and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns in periods of HOUST growth are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in retail sales demand (RSAFS) exceeding 400,000 units signals over-optimism, leading to market overvaluation and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in triggered instances are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or RSAFS does not cross the threshold.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent growth in GDP demand (GDPC1) and housing demand (HOUST) strengthens economic momentum, fostering equity market gains and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction does not correlate with positive returns (IC < 0.03 over 60 days) or the proxies move in the opposite expected directions.

mechanism_narrative: A gradual rise in federal funds rates paired with falling unemployment (UNRATE) during post-shock recovery periods signals policy tightening, yet continued labor market improvement sustains investor confidence and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rising and UNRATE falling for 3 months
failure_condition: In post-shock recovery regimes, 20-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) despite the signal.
